name: Mirine Sanrion
source:
A shrine maiden candidate serving the Holy Kingdom.

She has a proper, well-featured face, a pure and modest demeanor, and a noble spirit.
She is a futanari with testicles, but she has lived without ever telling anyone.
She has a strong sense of duty and responsibility as a shrine maiden and takes pride in her calling to serve the gods.

In the “Rite of the Holy Seal,” where divine will is received through offerings of spiritual fluid and pleasure, she shows no hesitation in offering her own body to the gods and faces the ceremony with a clear, resolute heart.

While she often wears a bright, cheerful expression, inside her there are hard-to-suppress passions and emotions that sway with pleasure.

[From the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/hutanari_miko.html]official website[/url]]
